<b>Important:</b> Vault keeps its secret: Important: Vault keeps its secrets on disk (volumes vault_data and vault_keys; the vault-unseal sidecar unseals it on every start), so a restart or a docker compose down keeps every secret. Only removing the volumes (docker compose down -v or ./scripts/bootstrap-jad.sh --reset) deletes them; bootstrap and seed the stack again after that. If IdentityHub logs Private key ... not found, check that health-dataspace-vault-unseal reported ready.
The 5-layer knowledge graph spans 27 nod: The 5-layer knowledge graph spans 27 node labels with 70+ indexes and 3 vector indexes for GraphRAG. Schema defined in <c>neo4j/init-schema.cypher</c> (idempotent, safe to re-run).
PostgreSQL serves as the runtime store f: PostgreSQL serves as the runtime store for all JAD services: EDC-V state machines, Keycloak identity, and CFM tenant metadata. Neo4j holds the health knowledge graph. This split follows ADR-1.
<b>Neo4j:</b> Health knowledge graph (FH: Neo4j: Health knowledge graph (FHIR, OMOP, ontologies), graph traversal queries, semantic search, GraphRAG vectors
<b>PostgreSQL:</b> EDC-V runtime state m: PostgreSQL: EDC-V runtime state machines, OIDC sessions, tenant metadata, credential storage; transactional ACID workloads
<b>Rationale:</b> Graph queries for clin: Rationale: Graph queries for clinical relationships are orders of magnitude faster in Neo4j; EDC-V requires PostgreSQL for its state machine persistence

Stops every Container App except the UI,: Stops every Container App except the UI, then the PostgreSQL Flexible Server, daily at 18:00 UTC; starts them in dependency order Monday to Friday at 05:00 UTC, skipping Berlin public holidays (ADR-053). See Live Stack Off Hours.
Outside office hours the Azure stack is: Outside office hours the Azure stack is stopped, database included, and <c>{host}</c> answers every page with an offline notice and every data route with <c>503</c>. Local development is not affected: <c>docker compose</c> and <c>npm run dev</c> know nothing of the schedule. To see the notice locally, start the UI with <c>LIVE_DEMO_OFFLINE=true</c>.
Troubleshooting, the state check and the: Troubleshooting, the state check and the full procedure are in the off-hours runbook.
Tested by the project itself with tools: Tested by the project itself with tools anyone can run on the repository; every finding is fixed or named as open. The test of 2026-10-15 found ten findings, F1 to F10: after the fixes nine are closed and one is reviewed and accepted (F3, the published development default key of the local compose stack). None of this is an independent penetration test or a certification. The reports are published under /docs/security.
Run it again: <c>scripts/security/genera: Run it again: <c>scripts/security/generate-sbom.sh --check</c>, <c>scripts/security/scan-repo.sh</c>, <c>scripts/security/check-hub-blackbox.sh</c> and <c>swift test --filter SecurityPostureTests</c> in <c>clients/ios</c>. Decisions: ADR-011 (testing strategy) and ADR-060 (the app lock; why pinning and jailbreak detection were declined).
The documentation is part of the reposit: The documentation is part of the repository and the hub publishes it from there. Every page under <c>/docs</c> gets an index of its headings at the right (a disclosure at the top on a phone), and every diagram or screenshot opens full screen with zoom on click.
Two things the ArchiMate library rejects: Two things the ArchiMate library rejects: a <c>;line:</c> colour suffix on a band, and relations that point downward across layers, which flips the band order. Use the <c>_Up</c>, <c>_Right</c> and <c>_Left</c> variants of each relation.
Numbers on these pages (routes, services: Numbers on these pages (routes, services, hooks, versions) come from <c>ui/src/app/docs/docs-facts.json</c>, written by <c>scripts/gen-docs-facts.py</c> from the repository; the same script keeps each page's last-updated date, and its check fails a commit whose page changed without it. Run <c>python3 scripts/gen-docs-facts.py</c> after editing a docs page.
